title: Evaluate termlens (TUI e2e test harness) for pebbles TUI tests
description:
EVALUATED 2026-09-19. Recommendation: ADOPT as a dev-dependency for a SMALL set of e2e tests once the TUI lands (resize, quit/alt-screen restoration, panic output, key/paste handling). Trycmd stays for CLI tests; ratatui TestBackend for draw logic.
- termlens 0.11.2: PTY-driven harness ('Playwright for the terminal'): real binary in real PTY -> VT emulator (vt100 + recovery parser for blink/conceal/strikethrough) -> screen grid; deadline-bounded wait/assert/snapshot, no sleeps. Clone at ~/repos/termlens.
- Actively maintained (last commit 2026-09-18), ~6 weeks old on crates.io, 3.5k downloads, MSRV 1.85, semver checks. Pre-1.0 with a declared stability candidate -> pin exact version.
- Ratatui's official snapshot-testing docs reference it as the PTY example.
- Toy test PASSED first run in 0.12s (ratatui 0.30 app spawned 80x24, alt-screen wait, key send, snapshot, quit, terminal-state restoration assert).
- Sauva's tests/terminal_e2e.rs is the pattern to copy: spawn helper, snapshot after a ready marker, send/wait_until loops, wait_exit + restoration asserts, zero sleeps.
- Risks: young crate (pin exact), real process per test case -> keep the e2e suite small.
